about:
Southern Furniture Company operates a retail furniture and home decor store in Forrest City, Arkansas, with a second location in Wynn. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company sells curated home decor and furniture through its physical showrooms and online platform. Its website organizes products by style categories, allowing shoppers to browse curated looks for different aesthetics. Financing options are available for purchases, and the company carries a range of brand-name products across home decor categories.

Its primary customers are residential shoppers seeking furniture and decorative accessories for their homes. The business serves the home decor and furniture retail sectors, with a focus on providing an in-store shopping experience complemented by online browsing.
